notes: DEATH PLACE CORRECTED; DUPLICATE RECORD (research 2026-07-03): Edward D. Harris, A Genealogical Record of Daniel Pond, and His Descendants (1873), pp. 100-102, entry #383, states plainly 'He died at Needham, Oct. 2, 1858' — not 'Milton, Norfolk, Massachusetts' as given here (the death date, 2 Oct 1858, matches exactly; only the town is wrong). He married three times: (1) Rachel Lyon, (2) in 1803 Hannah Stowell (this record's listed spouse, mother of Hannah Pond), (3) in 1831 widow Fanny Frost — only the Stowell marriage and its children appear in this tree. Also: this record and I182541959337 are the same individual duplicated under separate internal IDs with identical data — an import/merge artifact.
